player_prompt.intro:
I bɛ fɛnɛ Blackjack kɔnɔ dealer.
Anw ka kɛ i ye fɛnɛ 21 kɔnɔ, walasa i ma kɛ.
Anw tɛ, ka '[Hit]' ni fɛnɛ kɛ, ni '[Stand]' ni sɔrɔ.
J/Q/K = 10 lamɛnɛ; A = 11 ni 1, ɛlɛ bɛ sɔrɔ.

game_message.hand_result: Bolo {hand_number}: i {outcome}. A kɛlɛyɛlɛmɛ i ni {player_score} ye, Jɛri {dealer_score} ye.
game_message.all_complete:
=== Kɔlɔ wɔɔrɔ {num_hands} kɔlɔ kɔnɔ ===
I ka sɔrɔ: {wins}, I ka ɲɛ: {losses}, I ka tɛmɛ: {draws}

outcome.game_over: Jɛ̈ɛ̈ kɛ̈ɛ̈ ta sɔnna. Kɛ̈ɛ̈ fila taa: Jɛgɛ̈: {losses}, I: {wins}, Tɔɔrɔ: {draws}
